notes.title: NEW GAME IS IN WORKS!
notes.content:
Hey there, friends! 

We're up and running towards our dreams with your help. Thanks to you guys, we can now officially announce a new visual novel, which is in the development right now.  We've been doing it for quite a while now, along with other projects, and now the process has come to the point where we can show you a bit more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576350/Mansion_of_Memories_Prologue/

Please, welcome Mansion Of Memories!

Investigate the old manor, compete for the inheritance, or dive into mysteries left by your late aunt along with her will. Your choices decide whether other inhabitants of the mansion become your foes or friends… or someone special.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/6ea8539dd8e03dee33ed830e9a113e0ab0a87226.png

You could have never imagined finding yourself in such a situation. An unexpected inheritance? A mysterious mansion brimming with enigmas? It sounds like the plot of a classic Gothic novel. Yet, here you are – within the old manor, once owned by your late auntie, Ann Bloodworth.  

In the Prologue you’ll get to know how it all began, meet some of the manor’s dwellers, and pull the first string from the tangle of secrets. A bright sunny day gives way to a stormy night, and chilly wind howls within old walls, slamming the windows shut. Wait!.. Is it someone’s footsteps echoing in the attic?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/91c5a1a2c87ebbeb380a9b8245128b80c74b0a85.png
 
"Mansion of Memories" is a detective visual novel featuring funky chthonic creatures, romance, and a touch of erotica. You are one of the potential heirs to a substantial, albeit dubious, inheritance. You are invited to stay in the gloomy mansion, alongside a cast of characters, all connected to the matter at hand. And you’re here to figure out what the hell this is all about. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/52990cf1c4e7da08d08567403e756f6d55deb789.png

Solve mysteries, advance the plot, and remember that all your choices can have an impact.  
Why does the presence of a butler unsettle you so? What lies behind the echoing footsteps within a locked attic? And the most chilling issue of all – what extremes might Margaret, who's steadfast in her pursuit, resort to if you were to outpace her for the inheritance?  
 
This investigation embarks on a lengthy and intricate journey, yet you’ll be able to find friends to keep you company, whether it’s cheerful Liz, who is ready for any adventures, or Felix, enclosed in his own secrets... provided you’ll be able to earn his favor.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/05bc522d6c3704be7aaff9e80a980366e13235b7.png 

Who's to say whether you might discover a connection deeper than friendship amidst the shadows of late Ann Bloodworth's final wishes?

Features:
 
- rich narrative of classic detective plot;  
- wide variety of quests;  
- choices matter;
- love stories to enjoy;
- beautiful ladies... and other creatures, of, well, beauty.

Let us know what you think - we're really excited about this project. Don't forget to visit the game page and add it to your wishlist, join our social media to follow the progress! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575040/Mansion_of_Memories/

See you in the next one!

XO 
Shane

notes.title: A PEEK INTO THE STORIES
notes.content:
Hi there, friends! 

It's time I tell you a little bit more about the upcoming game. Buckle up for the first epic part of summaries! Pour yourself a big mug of tea or coffee and enjoy.

Sigma Epsilon Xi Party
Oh, college times! Isn't it just wonderful to attend a big party when you're done with all of the assignments and papers? Besides, your friend thinks you've nerded yourself out in your dorm room long enough, so it's time to shake the dust off your party clothes, grab a beer and talk to some girls in this big fraternity house. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/3c2d5b7b8978e8ae9dbbc5c5d5854e64dc66afaa.png
Dancing seems like a fun activity, and you spend lots of time on the dancefloor, but maybe it's time you need to rest a little. See that girl over there? Mind you she’s very sharp on her tongue, but it’s just an overview, everybody knows how gifted she is to the tips of her toes! Let's try and get into the conversation with her. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/745350c6ee753c0b193cc7eb4d1e305746eadca0.png
Oh, the raging sounds beside the bathroom make you think of changing your location. Though this cheer girl is obviously handling the situation herself, maybe you should step in for her and get a chance for a private show. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/2cc664f06359122b6568d3ebbd84e62ea77f357f.png
Name all you want, this party has endless opportunities! 

Exceptional Date
Ah, yes, the date. It seems like after a few very hot hookups Bella and Elliot have decided to bring their relationship to a whole new level - a romantic one, indeed. Elliot as a true gentleman just can’t not invite his beloved Bella to a restaurant, where the dim lights glow, where the music is quiet and lovely, where anyone would want to spend their first ever perfect date with an astonishing beautiful woman.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/d2a3c4262e45d7a5e31ddd45da4f3833334c00d3.png
But it’s hard to catch the attention of such a sumptuous woman. Bella just loves attention, who are we to blame? Can she pull herself together and give her boyfriend some? Elliot doesn’t seem to like such behavior. Jealous much, handsome little mouse? Looks like it, of course. Elliot must figure things out and come clean with Bella. Oh, it looks like she’s sorry and ready to prove it and make Elliot happier, just a smidge. She’s a lady, after all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/79737c462521c9a88fc25910a2571fb8a2cc5ac7.png
But who really needs other men, when the perfect one is already beside you, right? Bella thinks so, too, so she decides to give all of her attention to Elliot. Does he get what she means? Let’s just hope this night ends on the high-pitched moans... Only if someone else doesn’t break the idyll. Oh, look, it’s Judy, Bella’s good friend! It’s very nice to meet her at a place like this, especially when she looks so bored tonight. It’s a friend’s duty to help out, and Bella is a good friend. She’s ready to treat Judy with love and desire, but Elliot doesn’t look like he’s very fond of this idea. We’ll see if he changes his mind by the end of the night.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41198461/afe4169445aa48e040715166a53b9fac5b373146.png
How will this perfect date end? It's all up to you to decide.

Don't forget to check our social media every now and then and wishlist the game. I'll see you in the next one!

Love,
Shane
